title: Make the final source package installable under Windows CP936
objective: Remove locale-sensitive text from every pip requirements file, retain the existing launcher guard, and prove the replacement Git archive can install application and optional browser dependencies in a clean extraction before release.
approval_ref: The user asked to continue preparing the final version and previously directed a fresh install attempt while focusing on PDF release readiness.
notes: Preserve the failed clean-package browser dependency install as release evidence; do not publish the old 200dee7 archive.
Use ASCII-only requirements files because they are consumed directly by pip before application code can control decoding.
Do not change application behavior or call a model.
